# Alpine Trail Ridge Inn

> > Alpine Trail Ridge Inn is a mountain lodge in Estes Park, Colorado, offering convenient access to Rocky Mountain National Park with comfortable accommodations and local area expertise.

The inn serves as a gateway to RMNP adventures, providing guests with comprehensive guides to hiking trails, wildlife viewing, seasonal activities, and local attractions. Located near key park entrances including Beaver Meadows and Fall River, the property features various room types with mountain views and amenities designed for year-round Rocky Mountain experiences.

## Key Topics

- Rocky Mountain National Park (RMNP)
- Estes Park lodging and activities
- Bear Lake and Bear Lake Road
- Trail Ridge Road access
- Wildlife viewing (elk, bighorn sheep, moose)
- Hiking trails and outdoor recreation
- RMNP timed entry permits and park access
- Moraine Park and Horseshoe Park
- Seasonal activities (spring, summer, fall, winter)
- Lake Estes and Sprague Lake
- Fall River and Wild Basin areas
- Elk rut season (Elktober)
- Mountain views and scenic photography
- Local festivals and events
- Romantic getaways and date nights

## Accommodations & Amenities

- [Hotel Amenities](https://www.alpinetrailridgeinn.com/amenities): Hotel amenities including outdoor pool, WiFi & mountain views
- [Guest Reviews](https://www.alpinetrailridgeinn.com/accommodations/guest-reviews): Guest reviews and testimonials for Alpine Trail Ridge Inn lodging
- [Standard ADA Room - 2 Double Beds](https://www.alpinetrailridgeinn.com/accommodation/standard-ada-2-double-beds): ADA-accessible room with 2 double beds & Twin Sisters mountain views
- [Western Room - 1 Queen Bed](https://www.alpinetrailridgeinn.com/accommodation/western-1-queen-bed): Budget-friendly Western room with 1 queen bed, rustic cabin style
